subject: CloudSync: Proposed subprocessor roster + dataflow summary
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudsync.io>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference>
Cc: Anika Bose <anika@cloudsync.io>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CloudSync: Proposed subprocessor roster + dataflow summary

Hi Irene,

Hope you had a good week. Quick heads-up: CloudSync is updating our third-party roster as part of a quarterly vendor rationalisation. For customers in sensitive sectors we notify subprocessors in advance. Attached is the proposed list and a simple dataflow diagram. High level: we are adding three providers for the services below — all contractually bound via our standard DPA (we can provide the DPA draft and attestations):

- EdgeCache Ltd — CDN/edge caching (caches static responses and CDN logs).
- TelemetryOps Ltd — logging & metrics ingestion (session-level logs, pseudonymised identifiers only).
- EU Backup Partners — encrypted at-rest backups (stored in Frankfurt).

Action requested: please confirm within 30 days if you have any regulatory objections or need additional evidence (SOC 2, SCCs, KMS key controls). If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-min call next week to walk the list.

Attachments: cloudsync_subprocessors_20270402.csv (csv), dataflow_diagram_v1.png (png)

Thanks,

Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships
CloudSync Ltd
liam.oconnor@cloudsync.io
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudsync.io>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSync: Proposed subprocessor roster + dataflow summary

Liam —

Thanks for the notification and the attachments. Quick follow-ups from Redwood's compliance/security review so we can triage internally:

1) Which of the three subprocessors will have access to cleartext customer content (if any)? Please call out whether EdgeCache stores or serves any request bodies or only static assets.
2) Are TelemetryOps logs fully pseudonymised before transfer to them? We need a short description of the pseudonymisation step and where the mapping keys are stored.
3) For EU Backup Partners: confirm encryption-at-rest algorithm and whether key management is via CloudSync KMS or a partner-managed KMS (we prefer partner KMS with customer-controlled keys for backups containing PII).
4) Please provide copies of current security attestations (SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001) and any SCC/DPAs executed with the subprocessors. If any subprocessors rely on CloudSync's SCCs, note that explicitly.
5) Are any subprocessors doing processing in non-EEA locations? If so, specify which and what data is transferred.

We have an internal 30-day review window but raising the above will help speed it up. Markus and Priyom are looped for technical/security confirmation. If you can drop the SOC 2/attestation bundle and a draft redlineable DPA link that would be most helpful.

Thanks — can we aim to close during our review window? If you'd like a quick call, I can propose Tue/Wed next week.

—
Irene Choi
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0193
From: Anika Bose <anika@cloudsync.io>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudsync.io>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSync: Proposed subprocessor roster + dataflow summary

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the quick review. Answers inline and attachments included:

1) EdgeCache Ltd — serves cached static responses only; no request bodies are persisted. Cache logs contain request path and timestamp but not full request body.
2) TelemetryOps Ltd — we pseudonymise session identifiers at the ingestion edge (hash + salt) and mapping keys are held encrypted in CloudSync KMS (US region). No cleartext mapping leaves CloudSync except under subpoena. TelemetryOps processes aggregated telemetry and truncated session IDs.
3) EU Backup Partners — backups are AES-256 encrypted; keys are managed by CloudSync KMS but we are piloting a partner-managed KMS for accounts requiring customer-controlled keys (ETA Q3).
4) Attached is a zip with current attestations: Subprocessor_Security_Attestations.zip (contains EdgeCache_SOC2.pdf, TelemetryOps_iso27001.pdf, EU_Backups_AuditSummary.pdf). EdgeCache and TelemetryOps have signed SCCs with CloudSync (included).
5) Processing locations: EdgeCache (EU + US), TelemetryOps (EU), EU Backup Partners (FR). No other cross-border transfers beyond the mappings above.

We also put a draft DPA v3 up on DocuSign for convenience: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/CloudSync_DPA_v3 — this is editable and accepts comments.

Attachments: Subprocessor_Security_Attestations.zip (zip)

If you prefer, I can schedule a 20-min technical deep-dive with Priyom and Markus to walk the pseudonymisation flow and the SCC attachments.

Best,

Anika Bose
Legal Operations
CloudSync Ltd
anika@cloudsync.io
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudsync.io>, Anika Bose <anika@cloudsync.io>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudSync: Proposed subprocessor roster + dataflow summary

Thanks Anika — that is helpful and I appreciate the attachments.

Two quick internal notes / next steps:
- Priyom and Markus will review the attestation bundle and the pseudonymisation notes this week and flag any technical concerns.
- Legal (me) will circulate a short redline to the DPA if needed. Liam — if you can enable comments on the DocuSign draft (or send a redlineable Word copy) it's easiest for us.

We don't have an immediate regulatory objection based on what you shared; main items to confirm are:
- explicit confirmation that EdgeCache never receives request bodies for authenticated endpoints, and
- whether CloudSync will offer partner-managed KMS for backups for customers who require it (timetable and opt-in steps).

CC'ing Markus and Priyom to acknowledge they are picking up the technical review. We will aim to close the review by 2027-04-30 per your 30-day notice. If there's anything urgent before then, please flag.

Attachments: subprocessor_review_notes_20270409.pdf (internal checklist)

Regards,

Irene Choi
